prompt: A jewelry store with customers and staff. A jeweler is examining a diamond with a magnifying glass while sitting at a workbench. The jeweler, a senior expert, is older than the salesperson assisting the couple. A customer is trying on necklaces while standing in front of a mirror. Another customer is trying on a bracelet with three large pearls. A salesperson is showing rings to a couple while pointing at a display case. The display case contains four gold rings and a number of silver rings. The number of silver rings is one more than the number of gold rings. A security guard is watching the store while standing near the entrance door. An appraiser is weighing pearls on a scale while wearing gloves. On the appraiser's workbench, a tray holds a number of loose pearls, which is twice the number of pearls on the customer's bracelet.
